description: Type topics.setIamPolicy's HTTP 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT for a member service account that does not exist yet ('Service account service-N@gs-project-accounts.iam.gserviceaccount.com does not exist.'). Freshly provisioned Google service agents take a few seconds to become grantable; the generic BadRequest forced callers to match on the message.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: A policy member (service account) does not exist (HTTP 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT). Retryable while a just-created service agent propagates.
